# New York Post
> Breaking news, headlines, photos, and videos covering New York, U.S. politics, business, sports, entertainment, and lifestyle.

The New York Post is a long-running American news publication with broad coverage across local and national news, opinion, sports, celebrity, business, and culture. Its site organizes reporting into major editorial sections, topic hubs, video, podcasts, and archives.

## Main News Sections
- [News](https://nypost.com/news/): Main news hub for breaking stories, crime, politics, and general reporting.
- [Metro](https://nypost.com/metro/): New York City and regional coverage focused on local news, transit, and crime.
- [Politics](https://nypost.com/politics/): U.S. political news, campaigns, White House coverage, and policy reporting.
- [Business](https://nypost.com/business/): Business, markets, companies, personal finance, and economic news.
- [Opinion](https://nypost.com/opinion/): Editorials, columns, commentary, and analysis from Post contributors.
- [World News](https://nypost.com/tag/world-news/): International news coverage and major developments from around the world.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://nypost.com/entertainment/): Celebrity, TV, movies, music, media, and pop culture coverage.
- [Page Six](https://pagesix.com/): Celebrity news, gossip, events, and entertainment scoops from Page Six.
- [TV](https://nypost.com/entertainment/tv/): Television news, reviews, interviews, and streaming coverage.
- [Movies](https://nypost.com/entertainment/movies/): Film news, reviews, trailers, and box office reporting.
- [Music](https://nypost.com/entertainment/music/): Music industry news, artist coverage, and concert-related stories.
- [Media](https://nypost.com/tag/media/): Reporting on media companies, personalities, publishing, and broadcasting.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://nypost.com/sports/): Main sports section with scores, analysis, columns, and breaking updates.
- [NFL](https://nypost.com/tag/nfl/): National Football League news, game analysis, and player coverage.
- [MLB](https://nypost.com/tag/mlb/): Major League Baseball news, trades, standings, and team reporting.
- [NBA](https://nypost.com/tag/nba/): Basketball coverage including games, players, trades, and league news.
- [NHL](https://nypost.com/tag/nhl/): Hockey news, game coverage, player updates, and league developments.
- [College Sports](https://nypost.com/tag/college-sports/): College football, basketball, recruiting, and campus athletics coverage.
- [Betting](https://nypost.com/betting/): Sports betting news, picks, odds, and wagering analysis.

## Lifestyle & Features
- [Lifestyle](https://nypost.com/lifestyle/): Lifestyle reporting on health, relationships, travel, and home topics.
- [Health](https://nypost.com/tag/health/): Health news, wellness trends, medical studies, and public health stories.
- [Real Estate](https://nypost.com/tag/real-estate/): Property news, celebrity homes, listings, and housing market coverage.
- [Fashion and Beauty](https://nypost.com/tag/fashion-and-beauty/): Style, beauty trends, designer news, and celebrity fashion coverage.
- [Food and Drink](https://nypost.com/tag/food-and-drink/): Restaurant news, recipes, dining trends, and beverage coverage.
- [Travel](https://nypost.com/tag/travel/): Travel news, destination features, airline updates, and trip advice.

## Media Formats
- [Video](https://nypost.com/video/): Video hub featuring news clips, interviews, highlights, and original segments.
- [Podcasts](https://nypost.com/podcasts/): Podcast directory for New York Post shows and audio programming.
- [Photos](https://nypost.com/tag/photos/): Photo-driven stories, galleries, and visual coverage across sections.
- [Live Updates](https://nypost.com/tag/live-updates/): Ongoing live blogs and rolling coverage for major events.
- [Newsletters](https://nypost.com/newsletters/): Email newsletter sign-up page for recurring editorial updates.

## Special Coverage & Topic Hubs
- [Crime](https://nypost.com/tag/crime/): Crime reporting, police investigations, court cases, and public safety news.
- [Donald Trump](https://nypost.com/tag/donald-trump/): Coverage of Donald Trump, campaigns, legal cases, and political activity.
- [New York City](https://nypost.com/tag/new-york-city/): Topic hub for stories focused on New York City.
- [Israel-Hamas War](https://nypost.com/tag/israel-hamas-war/): Ongoing reporting and analysis on the conflict and its developments.
- [Immigration](https://nypost.com/tag/immigration/): Reporting on border policy, migration, and related political debates.
- [Education](https://nypost.com/tag/education/): Coverage of schools, universities, policy, and campus-related issues.

## Shopping & Commerce
- [Shopping](https://nypost.com/shopping/): Product recommendations, deals coverage, and commerce-focused editorial content.
- [Best Products](https://nypost.com/article/best-products/): Curated product guides and editor-selected recommendations.
- [Sales and Deals](https://nypost.com/tag/sales-and-deals/): Coverage of discounts, promotions, and major shopping events.
- [Mattress Reviews](https://nypost.com/tag/mattress-reviews/): Mattress buying guides, reviews, and sleep product comparisons.
- [Streaming](https://nypost.com/tag/streaming/): Streaming service guides, viewing recommendations, and platform updates.

## Games, Comics & Interactive
- [Games](https://nypost.com/games/): Puzzle and game hub including crosswords and other daily interactives.
- [Crossword](https://nypost.com/games/crossword/): Daily crossword puzzle and archive access.
- [Sudoku](https://nypost.com/games/sudoku/): Daily Sudoku puzzles with multiple difficulty levels.
- [Word Search](https://nypost.com/games/word-search/): Word search puzzle hub with playable daily games.
- [Comics](https://nypost.com/comics/): Comics and cartoon features published by the New York Post.

## Archives & Site Information
- [Covers](https://nypost.com/covers/): Archive of New York Post front and back page covers.
- [Today’s Paper](https://nypost.com/print/): Digital access point for the print edition and e-edition offerings.
- [Contact Us](https://nypost.com/contact/): Contact information, tips, and departmental communication channels.
- [Terms of Use](https://nypost.com/terms-of-use/): Legal terms governing use of the New York Post website.
- [Privacy Notice](https://nypost.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy policy describing data collection, cookies, and user rights.
- [Sitemap](https://nypost.com/sitemap_index.xml): XML sitemap index for discovering site content structure.
